entries.reason: License, upstream attribution notices, and legal policy documents preserve original Nightly Labs and OpenBot attribution.
entries.removalCondition: Keep LICENSE and NOTICE upstream attribution permanently; update policy and contributor docs when Pokebots legal policies replace upstream templates.

entries.reason: Historical release notes, changelog fragments, and design plans record prior releases and rename context.
entries.removalCondition: Never rewrite historical release entries; new fragments describe Pokebots by default.

entries.reason: Frozen SQLite migration files and released schema snapshots must stay byte-compatible for installed user databases.
entries.removalCondition: Never edit or rename frozen migrations.

entries.reason: Team API wire payloads, protocol headers, and sync markers remain compatible during the 60-day Release A compatibility window.
entries.removalCondition: Remove legacy wire aliases after Release B retires OpenBot Team API protocol identifiers.

entries.reason: Feedback repository fallback, hosted-server parsing, and agent import contracts keep legacy upstream repository identifiers for migration and compatibility.
entries.removalCondition: Remove after Release B drops legacy feedback and upstream repo fallbacks.

entries.reason: Contracts retain the @openbot workspace scope, IPC channel names, and Release A compatibility types.
entries.removalCondition: Remove after Release B renames the internal @openbot package scope and IPC contract names.

entries.reason: Desktop packaging, signing, Nix/Docker builds, and bundle identifiers preserve installed app identity, keychain entries, and macOS privacy grants through Release A.
entries.removalCondition: Remove after Release A3/Release B completes Pokebots installer identity cutover and data migration.

entries.reason: Main process keeps installed app identity, keychain service name, data directory, IPC channels, update feed fallbacks, and Release A2 main-process track work.
entries.removalCondition: Tighten after Release A2 main-process PR lands; remove identity and storage fallbacks in Release B.

entries.reason: Preload exposes the window.openbot IPC bridge and @openbot workspace imports kept stable through Release A.
entries.removalCondition: Remove after Release B migrates window.openbot and @openbot imports.

entries.reason: Backend runtime keeps existing local database paths, agent tool router names, MCP server prefixes, and @openbot imports through Release A.
entries.removalCondition: Remove internal tool and storage renames in Release B after data migration support ships.

entries.reason: Locale catalogs are owned by a parallel Release A2 i18n PR and retain kept compatibility phrases.
entries.removalCondition: Tighten token allowlist once the parallel Release A2 i18n PR lands.

entries.reason: Shared packages retain @openbot workspace imports, CSS tokens, telemetry event names, localStorage keys, and unit test fixtures through Release A.
entries.removalCondition: Remove @openbot scope and storage key aliases in Release B.

entries.reason: Renderer keeps @openbot imports, window.openbot bridge calls, CSS classes, localStorage keys, openbot-attachment scheme, and test fixtures through Release A; visible display defaults now use Pokebots.
entries.removalCondition: Remove remaining legacy storage keys, bridge globals, and @openbot imports in Release B.

entries.reason: Renderer HTML window title templates are updated alongside scripts/brand-layer.ts in a parallel Release A2 PR.
entries.removalCondition: Remove once renderer HTML entry titles default to Pokebots and brand-layer HTML rewriting is retired.

entries.reason: Storybook configuration and story fixtures retain @openbot package aliases and sample repository strings.
entries.removalCondition: Update stories and Storybook aliases in Release B.

entries.reason: Account Worker and web routes are updated in a parallel Release A track while keeping API compatibility with installed clients.
entries.removalCondition: Tighten after the parallel apps/auth-api Release A2 PR lands; remove compatibility aliases in Release B.

entries.reason: Mobile app bundle IDs, deep links, OTA channels, and Release A mobile branding are handled in a separate Release A track.
entries.removalCondition: Tighten after the parallel apps/mobile Release A PR lands; retire legacy bundle IDs in Release B.

entries.reason: Companion chat bots, status page, and site router retain legacy app identifiers and domain redirects during Release A.
entries.removalCondition: Retire or rebrand companion services in Release B after pokebots.xyz cutover completes.

entries.reason: Signal relay, nginx, coturn, and acme configs keep protocol names and fallback domain references through the compatibility window.
entries.removalCondition: Remove legacy Signal identifiers in Release B after all clients target signal.pokebots.xyz.

entries.reason: Bundled CLI shims, managed skills, plugin catalogs, and agent-import resources preserve existing CLI names and catalog schema.
entries.removalCondition: Update bundled CLI and catalog metadata in Release B.

entries.reason: Workspace manifests, lockfile, lint/test configs, patches, and this allowlist file reference @openbot workspace packages and build artifacts.
entries.removalCondition: Remove @openbot workspace entries in Release B when packages move to @pokebots.

entries.reason: CI workflows, issue templates, and review configs retain existing release workflow names and upstream references until Release A3 CI cutover.
entries.removalCondition: Update GitHub workflows and templates in Release A3/B.

entries.reason: Build, brand-layer, hosting, verification, and test scripts inspect or transform legacy tokens during Release A.
entries.removalCondition: Remove scripts/brand-layer.ts and tighten script allowlist entries in Release A3/B.

entries.reason: Architecture docs, analytics inventory, and repository agent skills document both legacy compatibility surfaces and Pokebots conventions.
entries.removalCondition: Refresh documentation in Release B once legacy names are retired.

entries.reason: Main and preload build outputs retain installed app identity, frozen migration SQL, keychain service compatibility, and feedback repo fallback through Release A.
entries.removalCondition: Tighten in Release B when installed identity and legacy migration strings are isolated.

entries.reason: Source maps embed original source file paths and comments.
entries.removalCondition: Not shipped as user-visible strings.

entries.reason: Built renderer and web bundles keep CSS tokens, storage keys, window.openbot bridge, openbot:// schemes, and compatibility links through Release A while blocking unallowlisted visible OpenBot and nightly-labs/openbot leaks.
entries.removalCondition: Remove legacy technical identifiers in Release B.
